title: Anti-pseudomonas IgY to Prevent Infections in Cystic Fibrosis
brief_summary: Hypothesis: Daily gargling with specific avian antibodies against Pseudomonas aeruginosa will prevent infections with this bacteria in patients with Cystic fibrosis (CF).
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Clinical diagnosis of cystic fibrosis
* Colonized with Pseudomonas aeruginosa
* informed consent

Exclusion Criteria:

* Egg allergy
